Describe the visitor-facing change and why it is needed.

Validation performed:

For new or changed pages, sections, or shared presentation styles, complete the [independent finished-layout review](https://github.com/caribousun/focuschrist-website/blob/main/docs/finished-layout-review.md):

- [ ] Identify the actual independent reviewer, exact reviewed candidate, affected routes/shared-style consumers, and review evidence.
- [ ] Inspect actual rendered desktop (1280px), phone (390px), and narrow-phone (320px) layouts, including relevant expanded states.
- [ ] Check inner text gutters, bottom clearance beneath actions (including wrapped buttons), overflow, and visible keyboard focus.
- [ ] Check enlarged text; state the method and limits. Check affected print scope separately without claiming unperformed native print/PDF proof.
- [ ] Record PASS/HOLD and unresolved limits. After deployment, verify affected public layout and interactions before calling the release complete.

If the change has no page/section/presentation effect, state why these layout checks are not applicable. Do not check an item based solely on a plan, a previous revision, or someone else's unattributed execution.
